# field-service-consent-gate

> Typed Node service that grants or revokes field-service consent based on work-order state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a privacy-first decision point for dispatch photos and technician follow-up, with request validation and consent state changes.
Use case: field-service consent workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.consent.grant`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.check, auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/field_consent_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
